ActorTalk: I can't believe someone got into Babylonia again. You two are alright, I hope?
It was a mess. The Arctic mechanoids that came with him all shut down the moment the Frostheart Emperor left. I'm still figuring out why.
I know. Which brings me to the President's "message." We still don't know why the glacier spawned Corrupted on that scale, but Babylonia won't stand by during a crisis.
[PlayerName], after an emergency meeting, the military has decided to send you, alongside other units, to assist the Arctic Route Union and eliminate the Corrupted threat.
Yes, Dark Aries and some unaffiliated Constructs will be joining this operation.
I'm grateful for your help, but I know what things are like in Babylonia. Do we really have the manpower for this?
Well, we detected Ascendant signals in the Arctic.
This enemy we're dealing might not be what they seem. That's exactly why the military is sending you personally to support the Arctic Route Union.
For the full report, check in with the liaison. Meanwhile, the Science Council is already working on analyzing the frame data we recovered.
After all, that Frostheart Emperor infiltrated Babylonia just to get access to that data.
Understood. On behalf of the Arctic Route Union, I thank you.
Let's go, Commandant. The battlefield's a mess. We need to get ready before we move out.
Your current gear is way better than those egg suits.
Ascendants... could they be connected to the earlier crash?
We're not using those egg suits again, right?
